metadata.description: Plan-as-artifact with a per-increment edit gate, safe stacked-branch rebases, and the cmux crew layer, one plugin per feature.

plugins.name: deep-plan
plugins.description: Plan a change as a reviewable artifact, then refuse edits until the human authorizes each increment.

plugins.name: restack
plugins.description: Rebase a stack of branches onto a moved base without hand-resolving generated files, then run CI's staleness and breaking-change checks locally.

plugins.name: bash-guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive shell commands before they run: force pushes, recursive deletes at dangerous paths, hook bypasses, destructive SQL.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: The cmux crew layer: every Claude session on a board, ranked by who needs you, with plan rows and go chips. macOS and cmux only; run `crew apply` after installing.

plugins.name: seamux-mods
plugins.description: deep-plan inside the terminal: a /plan-pane pane, a `go next` band when the gate refuses, and the plan and cache clock in the status line. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.
